proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  intro T w F u a b hu
  classical
  obtain ⟨hlen, hprefix, htake, hdrop⟩ :=
    M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.completion_word_split (w - 1) u a b hu
  obtain ⟨hpa, hga⟩ := M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.prefix_algebra
    T _ (u.take (w - 1)) a
  obtain ⟨hpb, hgb⟩ := M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.prefix_algebra
    T _ (u.drop (w - 1)) b
  have ht : (u.take (w - 1)).length ≤ w - 1 := by
    simp only [List.length_take]
    omega
  have hd : (u.drop (w - 1)).length ≤ w - 1 := by
    simp only [List.length_drop]
    omega
  simp [M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.wordValid,
    M5.ConditionalResidueCount.feasible,
    hlen, htake, hdrop,
    M5.ConditionalResidueCount.selectedGcd,
    hpa, hpb, hga, hgb,
    M5.ConditionalResidueCount.fits, ht, hd,
    Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_left_comm]
